nodes.label: Flutter Web Release Build
nodes.rationale: The workflow supplies /Janosos_Game/ as the base href so the web build resolves assets correctly when hosted under the GitHub Pages repository path.

nodes.label: Scoped Lint Customization
nodes.rationale: Rules may be customized globally, while line- or file-level suppression is available when disabling a rule for the entire project would be too broad.

nodes.label: Flutter and Flame Architecture
nodes.rationale: Flutter provides natively compiled UI capabilities while Flame supplies the 2D game loop, component system, collision handling, and basic physics.

nodes.label: Flutter Base Href Placeholder
nodes.rationale: The base href is replaced during flutter build so deployments under a non-root path can resolve resources from the correct URL prefix.

nodes.label: Relocatable Linux Bundle Layout
nodes.rationale: The executable, Flutter library, ICU data, package assets, and native assets are installed into fixed relative locations because only the bundled executable resolves its resources correctly.

nodes.label: Visual Studio In-place Bundle Layout
nodes.rationale: Support files are installed next to the executable so the application can run directly from Visual Studio instead of requiring a separate Linux-style bundle.
